text: You can return products that are undamaged and complete. Trying the product is allowed, but items with signs of use are not accepted. You only need the order number for a return; an invoice is not required. Returns must be requested within 30 days from the delivery date; after 30 days, returns are not accepted and the product will be evaluated under warranty. If you use the contracted carrier Anadolu Kargo for returns, the shipping is free by showing the return code at the branch. If you send the product with your own carrier, the shipping cost will not be refunded. Once the product arrives at the warehouse and passes inspection, the refund will be processed within 5 business days to the original payment method. For cash on delivery orders, refunds are made to the account holder's IBAN.
